completion_policy: Complete means the repository has an explicit Conductor requirements and design authority, workflow-level review/checkpoint rules, no-stub completion semantics, archive evidence for this governance track, and focused validation proving those documents exist. This track does not complete every dependent implementation track or replace each track's own validation, release, publication, or runtime evidence.

implemented: workflow rules requiring conductor-review at phase and track boundaries
no-stub completion semantics linked to requirements and workflow evidence
archive evidence contract for this governance track
not_implemented: automatic completion of dependent implementation tracks
replacement of per-track validation, release, or publication evidence
runtime enforcement outside the repository Conductor workflow

gap_register.gap: This track governs Conductor authority documents and workflow rules; it does not complete every dependent implementation track.
gap_register.rationale: Dependent tracks consume the authority and provide their own implementation, validation, and release evidence.

gap_register.gap: Runtime enforcement outside the repository's Conductor workflow remains future work.
gap_register.rationale: The completed scope is repository-local governance, tests, and workflow documentation. External enforcement would need a separate implementation track with its own contracts and validation.
